steps.title: Prepare double‑stranded primers A and B
steps.instruction: Order oligos Tn5‑rev, Tn5‑A and Tn5‑B (standard desalting). In separate 1.5 mL Eppendorf tubes, mix equal molar amounts of Tn5‑rev with Tn5‑A to make Primer A, and Tn5‑rev with Tn5‑B to make Primer B. Denature each mixture at 70 °C for 1 min (30 s if using a PCR tube), then chill on ice to anneal.

steps.title: Dilute and arrange indexing primers
steps.instruction: Synthesize Illumina Nextera XT Index primers (i5/i7 adapters) and order from IDT. Dilute each primer to 10 µM and place them in a 96‑well plate (e.g., well A1 contains index N702 and S502). Keep the plate sealed and avoid cross‑contamination.

steps.title: Assemble transposome for tagmentation
steps.instruction: For up to ~280 samples, combine in a tube: Tn5 (100 µL, 340 µg; adjust volume if enzyme concentration differs), pre‑annealed Primer A (64 µL of 100 µM), pre‑annealed Primer B (64 µL of 100 µM), and 2X DF buffer (128 µL). Total volume = 356 µL. Incubate at room temperature for at least 60 min (longer incubations are acceptable).

steps.title: Assay transposase activity (optional)
steps.instruction: Prepare a 20 µL test reaction: H₂O 13.5 µL, 5X TAPS‑MgCl₂‑PEG 8000 4 µL, target DNA 1 µL (50 ng/µL), Tn5 1.5 µL. Incubate 10 min at 55 °C, add 2.5 µL 0.2 % SDS, incubate another 7 min at 55 °C. Run the sample on an agarose gel; a successful transposase yields a smear from ~100 bp to ~1000 bp.

steps.title: Tagment DNA and deactivate Tn5
steps.instruction: Mix 10 µL per sample: 5X TAPS buffer 2 µL, 40 % PEG 2 µL, Tn5 1.2 µL, DNA (~10 ng/µL) 1 µL, water 3.8 µL. Incubate 10 min at 55 °C. Add 2.5 µL 0.2 % SDS and incubate another 7 min at 55 °C to deactivate Tn5.

steps.title: PCR amplify with indexed primers
steps.instruction: Set up a 25 µL PCR per sample: tagmented product 12.5 µL, 5X PCR buffer 5 µL, HiFi PCR enzyme 0.2 µL, dNTP (10 mM) 0.3 µL, Index1 (10 µM) 2.5 µL, Index2 (10 µM) 2.5 µL, water 2 µL. Run the program: 72 °C 3 min (gap fill), then 10 cycles of –98 °C 30 s, –98 °C 30 s, –63 °C 30 s, 72 °C 3 min.

steps.title: Check evaporation and adjust volumes
steps.instruction: Inspect wells at the border of the 96‑well plate for reduced volume. If evaporation is observed, add sterile water to bring each well back to the intended volume before proceeding to bead purification.

steps.title: Double‑size selection with AMPure beads
steps.instruction: Warm AMPure beads to room temperature for 30 min. For each sample: (1) add 7.5 µL beads, vortex, incubate 10 min RT; place on magnetic stand until solution clears, then transfer supernatant to a new tube. (2) add 4.8 µL beads, incubate 10 min RT, magnetic stand ~5 min, keep supernatant. (3) add 70 µL 80 % ethanol, quickly flip the plate on the magnet and pour off liquid; wipe plate dry. Repeat the ethanol wash once more. (4) air‑dry beads ~5 min RT. (5) elute DNA with 20 µL water, vortex, incubate 5–10 min RT, magnetic stand ~5 min, transfer supernatant to a clean tube, discarding the last 3–4 µL to avoid bead carry‑over.

steps.title: Quantify libraries and pool samples
steps.instruction: Measure each library concentration using Qubit dsDNA HS Assay Kit (or TECAN Infinite 200 PRO for high‑throughput). Normalize by taking 20 ng from each sample and combine into a single pool. Assess the pooled insert size on an Agilent TapeStation D1000 (High Sensitivity).

steps.title: Optional additional bead cleanup if contamination
steps.instruction: If primer dimers are detected in the TapeStation trace, add 0.75 × volume of AMPure beads to the pooled library and repeat the bead‑based steps 4–7 of the double‑size selection (i.e., two‑step bead binding, ethanol washes, drying, and elution).
